F-10 Critical WCAG 1.1.1 / 4.1.2 · Level A
Icon-only Navigation Without Labels
Flights, Hotels, Trains, Cars icons may lack aria-label or aria-hidden. Screen readers announce raw file names or redundant noise.
🔧 Manual keyboard + screen reader test
F-11 Critical WCAG 4.1.3 · Level AA
Critical Alert Banner Missing ARIA Live Region
"Middle East Update — Disruption" banner lacks role="alert" or aria-live="assertive". Screen reader users are never notified of safety-critical travel disruption.
🔧 Manual — axe
Search Results — Select Departing Flight
F-12 · F-13 · F-14
12
13
14
F-12 Critical WCAG 1.1.1 · Level A
Amenity Icons Without Text Alternatives
Seat, baggage, meal icons on flight cards have no text alternative, tooltip, or aria-label. Screen reader users receive zero amenity information.
🔧 Manual inspection
F-13 Major WCAG 1.4.1 · Level A
Color as Only Means to Convey Policy Status
Red flag 🚩 indicates out-of-policy fare using color as the primary signal. ~8% of males with red-green color blindness may miss this completely.
🔧 Manual — colour contrast analysis
F-14 Minor WCAG 1.3.1 · Level A
Filter Bar Overflow Without Scroll Affordance
"Sustainability" filter is truncated at the right edge with no visual affordance that more filters exist. Users may miss available filter options.
🔧 Manual visual inspection
Search Results — Fare Expansion Panel
F-15
15
F-15 Minor WCAG 1.1.1 · Level A
Decorative Image Missing Null Alt Attribute
Ticket image in fare expansion panel is purely decorative but likely lacks alt="". Screen readers read out the file name creating unnecessary noise.
🔧 Manual DOM inspection
Customize Your Flight
F-15 · F-16
15
16
F-15 Minor WCAG 1.1.1 · Level A
Decorative Flight Image Missing Null Alt
The airport/architecture photo in the flight summary sidebar is decorative but likely lacks alt="". Screen readers will read out the filename.
🔧 Manual DOM inspection
F-16 Minor WCAG 1.3.3 · Level A
Seat Unavailability Message Lacks Context
"Seat selection will be available at check in." gives no information on when check-in opens or what action to take. Cognitive accessibility issue.
🔧 Manual content evaluation
Traveler Information Form
F-17 · F-18 · F-19
17
18
19
F-17 Major WCAG 1.4.1 / 1.3.1 · Level A
Mandatory Fields Indicated by Color and Symbol Only
Required fields use a red asterisk (*) as sole mandatory indicator. Not communicated programmatically — aria-required missing. Screen reader users may submit incomplete forms.
🔧 Manual + axe
F-18 Major WCAG 3.3.2 · Level A
Date Fields Use Disappearing Placeholder as Format Guide
"mm/dd/yyyy" placeholder in Date of Birth and Date of Expiration disappears on focus. Indian users (dd/mm/yyyy standard) face format ambiguity at a critical point.
🔧 Manual — locale check
F-19 Minor WCAG 1.3.4 · Level AA
Phone Fields Default to Incorrect Country Code
All phone fields (Home, Work, Mobile) default to US +1 flag despite the user accessing egencia.co.in from India. Creates friction in time-sensitive booking.
🔧 Manual — locale check
Confirmation / Draft State
F-20 · F-21
20
21
F-20 Major WCAG 4.1.3 · Level AA
Draft Status Banner Not Announced to Screen Readers
"Saved as a draft — This reservation is not yet booked" banner lacks role="status" or aria-live. A screen reader user may believe their booking is confirmed. High-stakes error.
🔧 Manual screen reader test
F-21 Critical WCAG 1.1.1 · Level A
Amenity Icons Repeated Without Labels (Systemic)
The inaccessible amenity icons from F-12 reappear in itinerary detail (Amenities row per flight leg) with no text alternative. Confirms a systemic design system icon component issue.
🔧 Manual inspection
02 · Visual Solutions — Before / After

Each solution uses cropped regions from the real Egencia screenshots as the Before state, with the recommended fix shown alongside.

F-01 Critical Missing Form Labels WCAG 1.3.1 / 4.1.2 · Level A
✕ Before — Current state
No visible label — placeholder is the only identifier
Username or email
Password
⚠ Placeholder disappears on typing. Screen reader users have no field context after focus.
<label> elements are absent or orphaned.
→
✓ After — Recommended fix
Persistent visible label above each input
Username or email (required)
username@company.com
Password (required)
••••••••
✓ <label for="username"> associated via for/id. Labels always visible. aria-required="true" on inputs.
F-08 Critical Missing Visible Focus Indicator WCAG 2.4.7 · Level AA
✕ Before — No focus ring
No visible focus on keyboard navigation
Forgot password?
⚠ CSS outline: none suppresses all focus rings. Keyboard users cannot determine which element is active.
→
✓ After — 2px focus ring
Focus clearly visible on all interactive elements
Forgot password?
✓ :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2665FF; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }
F-11 Critical Alert Banner Missing ARIA Live Region WCAG 4.1.3 · Level AA
✕ Before — Silent to screen readers
⚡ Middle East Update - Disruption
Update: 06MAR26 — Airspace restrictions in effect. Review your upcoming travel.
⚠ No role="alert" or aria-live. Screen readers never announce this safety-critical banner.
→
✓ After — Announced immediately
role="alert" aria-live="assertive"
⡾ Middle East Update - Disruption
Update: 06MAR26 — Airspace restrictions in effect. Review your upcoming travel.
✓ Screen reader announces banner on load. Wrapper: <div role="alert" aria-live="assertive">

F-17 Major Mandatory Fields Indicated by Color and Symbol Only WCAG 1.4.1 / 1.3.1 · Level A
✕ Before — Red asterisk only
First name *
Poushali
Date of birth *
mm/dd/yyyy
⚠ * is visual only. aria-required missing. No programmatic mandatory indication for AT users.
→
✓ After — Text + ARIA
First name (required)
Poushali
Date of birth (required)
DD/MM/YYYY
✓ "(required)" in label text. aria-required="true" required on all mandatory inputs.
F-18 Major Date Fields Use Disappearing Placeholder as Format Guide WCAG 3.3.2 · Level A
✕ Before — Placeholder disappears
Date of birth *
Format hint gone on focus →
Date of Expiration *
mm/dd/yyyy
⚠ mm/dd/yyyy vanishes when user clicks in. Indian users expect dd/mm/yyyy — format confusion causes errors.
→
✓ After — Persistent hint below field
Date of birth (required)
📅 15 / 03 / 1990
Enter as DD/MM/YYYY — e.g. 15/03/1990
Date of Expiration (required)
DD / MM / YYYY
Enter as DD/MM/YYYY
✓ Helper text persists below field. Locale-aware: dd/mm/yyyy for .co.in domain.
F-20 Major Draft Status Banner Not Announced to Screen Readers WCAG 4.1.3 · Level AA
✕ Before — Silent status banner
ℹ️
Saved as a draft
This reservation is not yet booked. Please book it to confirm your travel.
⚠ No role="status" or aria-live. A screen reader user may believe their booking is confirmed. Very high-stakes error in corporate travel.
→
✓ After — Announced on load
role="alert" aria-live="assertive"
⏳
Saved as a draft — not yet booked
Complete payment below to confirm your reservation.
